name: claude-codex-workflow
description: Claude plans or implements; for Codex-implemented plans Claude hands off automatically and reviews the result, with parallel background checks, alignment review and a Playwright UI audit. Local only, no merge conflicts. graphify and caveman for both agents; Impeccable design skills are optional.

plugins.name: claude-codex-workflow
plugins.description: Set up the Claude + Codex workflow in any project with one command (/claude-codex-workflow:setup installs Claude Code, Codex CLI, Playwright and graphify; Impeccable is optional and asked about). Local-only: no tracked file changes. Claude asks implement-or-orchestrate on every plan, checks it against criteria, sends it to Codex itself, and reviews the result automatically with parallel checks, alignment review and a Playwright UI audit.
